I made the `householdId` deterministic and reworked everything that keys off the household. Changes in `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:

Owners with the same last name and postcode now share it automatically.

2. **`addOwner`** — computes the household id from `owner.getPostcode()` instead of the address, and stores it (so `householdMemberCount`, computed via `countHouseholdMembers` keyed on that id, and duplicate detection all use the computed value).

Since a matching household now means the record already exists, a second owner with the same lastName+postcode is rejected as a **409 household duplicate**, unless `sharesHousehold` is set, which only bypasses that block (it no longer creates the link — the link is computed).

(The soft-match key was exactly `(lastName, postcode)` = the household key, so a co-member reached here can only be a declared one.)

Supporting doc/message updates in `DuplicateHouseholdException` and `ExceptionControllerAdvice` now describe the `(lastName, postcode)` key and name `postcode` (rather than `address`) in the 409 `errors` array.
